Subject: Orbit / Redwood / CloudForge — consolidate demo?

Hi Priya / Vanessa,

Thanks again for yesterday's discovery. Orbit is excited to see both the marketplace listing flow and the SI integration path in one session. Markus and I discussed running a single 90-minute tri-party demo instead of two separate 45-minute runs — saves time for the customer's procurement and lets us tie the architecture to the deployment path.

Constraints from Orbit's side:
- EU procurement folks prefer 10:00–13:00 CET windows next week (Nov 30–Dec 3).
- They want the first 30 minutes focused on marketplace listing and pricing flow (owned by Vanessa), then 45 minutes for the SI technical deep dive (Markus/Jonas), and a 15-minute wrap with Q&A and next steps.

Can Redwood commit to a triage run that covers: 1) hosting/region/latency tradeoffs for Azure marketplace vs Dedicated, 2) model variants we recommend for low-latency EU inference, 3) end-to-end onboarding steps for the SI?

I've attached a rough agenda (demo-agenda-v2.pdf) and a mutual action plan (mutual-action-plan.xlsx) — whiteboard items are high level.

If a single 90-minute slot is tight, propose a fallback: 60-minute technical + 30-minute procurement follow-up.

Best,
Samantha
Head of Partnerships — Orbit Systems

- Rishi will coordinate billing and contract touchpoints; he asked I flag that any marketplace flow touching reserved capacity needs a note on Dedicated vs Hosted billing split.

Availability: Vanessa and Jonas are free for 90-minute blocks on 2026-11-30 10:30–12:00 CET and 2026-12-02 11:00–12:30 CET. We can also do 2026-12-01 10:00–11:30 CET if needed.

Action items I propose now:
1) Orbit to confirm attendee list + preferred date (pick top 2).
2) Markus to confirm CloudForge adaptor version for the live demo.
3) Vanessa/Jonas to get 45m dry run with Orbit a day before.
4) Rishi and Samantha to sync on procurement expectations and what to surface in the 15m wrap.

Markus / Samantha: can you confirm dates and the adaptor version by EOD Thursday? We'll lock a calendar and follow up with a Drive link to the final deck.

Thanks — Priya
